notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Mirrari's Wake triggers for each land tapped this way, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
